steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Bollywood is the Hindi-language film industry based in Mumbai, producing more films annually than Hollywood and characterised by musical numbers, melodrama and family-centred narratives. | Key Fact: Nollywood is the Nigerian film industry, one of the largest in the world by output, known for low-budget direct-to-video productions that reflect local cultures and social issues. | Key Fact: Chinese cinema encompasses mainland China, Hong Kong and Taiwan, with a history spanning martial arts cinema, Fifth Generation art films and contemporary blockbuster productions. | Key Fact: World film industries differ from Hollywood in their production contexts, funding models, distribution networks and relationships with domestic audiences.
